# Fundamental Periods and Site Properties

## Rock impoundment

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-SHT.RI
#| tbl-cap: "Shear modulus, shear-wave velocity, inhomogeneity factor and fundamental periodS for different confidence levels" 
TBL <- SHT[ID=="RI",.(ID,Name,USCS,level,b,s,Hs,Go,VSo,mo,lo,an,Ts)]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE)
  
```

# Seismic Coefficients 

## Rock impoundment (AEP=1/10,000)

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-kh.RI
#| tbl-cap: "Seismic Coefficients for different confidence levels and return periods" 

p_TARGET <- "mean"
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
ID_TARGET <- "RI"
TR_TARGET <- 10000

TBL <- KIT[ID== ID_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p==p_TARGET]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE)
  
```
